g.text: Dots show medians; lines extend to p95. These are distributions, not confidence intervals.
Same 45-second English input; three runs per model/configuration; partial cadence 0.6 s. The dotted line marks 1 second.
Lower silence thresholds change segmentation and sample counts. No browser delivery timing is included; see the matched-caption analysis.
